gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 recognizes a related domain-preservation failure for mollified inputs, but it does not identify the distinct false inclusion M_ξ(B_r(x*))⊆B_r(x*) or the failure to control distance from x*. The gold issue concerns localization in the center's neighborhood, not merely whether F[x_ξ] is defined.

ISSUE-007 identifies failure of uniform mollification/approximation over a fixed ball around one center, whereas the gold issue is the reversed quantifier order requiring one finite network and smoothing level to work simultaneously for every center. The prediction does not diagnose that global-versus-center-dependent quantifier failure.
